title: x.c2pa.export — a declared, unimplemented mapping to C2PA (STUB)
description: STATUS: STUB. This node type records an INTENT to interoperate with C2PA and the mapping that intent would use. It is an x.* extension on purpose (law 12): no core.* node depends on it, every reader that does not know it skips it and loses nothing, and nothing in werk's constitution is hostage to another consortium's schedule. READ spec/X-C2PA-EXPORT.md BEFORE USING THIS: it states plainly what has and has not been done. In particular, at the time this schema was written no werk tool emits a C2PA manifest, no mapping in this file has been run through a C2PA validator, and werk's signature chain is NOT a C2PA claim signature — it has no trust list and no certificate authority behind it, which is a different security model rather than a weaker version of the same one. A node of this type asserts only that its author wrote down a mapping.

status.description: 'intent' — a mapping has been written down and nothing has been generated. 'generated-unvalidated' — a manifest was produced by some tool and has not been checked by a C2PA validator. 'generated-validated' — a manifest was produced AND a named validator accepted it, and 'validation' says which one. The three words exist so that nobody has to infer how much work was actually done.

target_spec.description: Which version of the C2PA specification the mapping was written against, and when it was read. Written down because a mapping to an unnamed version of a moving specification is not checkable.

mapping.description: Ordered list of correspondences: a werk field, the C2PA assertion or field it would become, and how faithful that correspondence is.

werk.description: Source, as a node type plus a JSON path, e.g. 'core.recipe /steps/0/model/id'.

c2pa.description: Destination, as an assertion label plus a field, e.g. 'c2pa.actions /actions/0/softwareAgent'.

fidelity.description: 'exact' — the same fact, losslessly. 'lossy' — the fact survives but detail is dropped, and 'note' says which. 'approximate' — the two fields mean similar but not identical things, which is the category that causes wrong answers downstream and therefore gets its own word.

gaps.description: MANDATORY. werk facts with no C2PA counterpart, and C2PA obligations werk does not meet. A mapping document that lists only what lines up is marketing.
